source.pages: Design Quirks p82-95; Negative Quirk Table p145

format: A Mech lists quirk ids in its `quirks` array (see mechs.json). Weapon-scoped quirks are objects naming their weapon: { "id": "poor_cooling_jacket", "weapon": "ac20" }. A weapon-scoped quirk applies only when the entry names a weapon and the firing weapon matches it; an entry without a `weapon` is inert.

rules.target: Adds to ranged weapon attack Target Numbers.
rules.psr: Adds to Piloting Skill Roll Target Numbers.
rules.heat: Adds heat when a weapon is fired.

quirks.name: Poor Targeting (Short)
quirks.description: All ranged attacks at Short range receive a +1 Target Number modifier.

quirks.name: Poor Targeting (Medium)
quirks.description: All ranged attacks at Medium range receive a +1 Target Number modifier.

quirks.name: Poor Targeting (Long)
quirks.description: All ranged attacks at Long range receive a +1 Target Number modifier.

quirks.name: Sensor Ghosts
quirks.description: The sensor suite projects ghost images: all ranged attacks receive a +1 Target Number modifier.

quirks.name: Inaccurate Weapon
quirks.description: The named weapon receives a +1 Target Number modifier. Cost varies with the weapon.

quirks.name: Cramped Cockpit
quirks.description: The Mech receives a +1 Piloting Skill Roll modifier.

quirks.name: Hard to Pilot
quirks.description: The Mech receives a +1 Target Number modifier to all Piloting Skill Rolls.

quirks.name: Unbalanced
quirks.description: The Mech receives a +1 Target Number modifier to PSRs when entering a hex that requires PSRs.

quirks.name: Poor Cooling Jacket
quirks.description: The named weapon generates 1 more point of heat than normal when fired.
